content.short: Hyperstitions turns prediction markets into coordination markets where backers help outcomes happen.
content.description: Hyperstitions reframes the prediction market so that those betting on an outcome are also positioned to bring it about, turning a forecast into a coordination device. It is a deliberate inversion of the usual claim that prediction markets are neutral observers, and it raises the obvious question of where forecasting ends and manipulation begins.
content.meta: Prediction markets reworked so the people betting on an outcome help bring it about.
